analysis: The only changed file is docs/architecture/inference.md. It is documentation with no code or config change. Unit :4 is base text, lines 796-1045. Unit :5 is head text, lines 1-402. They cover different ranges and no patch hunks were supplied, so I could not diff the sections. I found no prose that weakens a threat-model control. Documented behavior touching security-relevant areas: (1) Deadline admission (head 270-304) now uses measured EWMAs directly with no 0.5 multiplier. This is a scheduling and availability policy for the first-content deadline, not a confidentiality control. Actual deadline expiry, memory admission and the physical KV/service reservations still apply. The deadline catalog is empty, so qualified profiles are not active. (2) Calibration (head 121-163) uses local-only startup warmup and idle probes. They do not train rates or produce billing counters, and they stop on foreground requests. (3) The MTP assistant staging text (head 377-391) keeps retained-weight accounting and pins. It touches T-029/T-028 resource handling only through memory charges. (4) Base text 796-1045 describes native MiMo media decode accounting, in-memory video assets (no payload written to disk), audio rejection and media-prefix non-reuse. This stays consistent with T-050 and T-041, which require that no plaintext media touches disk and that media is not cached. (5) The prefix-cache and SSD references only point to prefix-cache.md. Nothing there changes the T-041 posture (30-minute TTL, HMAC-keyed names, account-scoped cacheSalt). No TTL, scope or at-rest metadata change is stated. Because the sections could not be diffed and the unit text was partial, a later pass should check the full patch for any removed security statement, especially in the unseen middle of the file (head 402-795).
